title: Turnover
definition: Turnover in ecology refers to the seasonal or periodic mixing of water layers in a lake or reservoir, driven by temperature-induced density changes, which redistributes nutrients and dissolved oxygen.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding aquatic ecosystem dynamics, eutrophication, and the impact of climate change on freshwater biodiversity.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Turnover.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
